detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same 24-year-old Chinese man throughout, same face, same short black hair, same faded pale-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm over dark grey work trousers. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. His eyes stay aimed at the right of frame following something leaving; as the door clicks shut off-screen his eyelids open a fraction wider and his pupils fix. The speaker (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, colder than the earlier lines, the voice comes from off-screen while nobody in frame moves their lips,: <d>[Chinese] 可我没想到，</d> while their lips remain completely closed. a door clicking shut off-screen, then insects. The muscle along his jaw draws tight a millimetre at a time until it holds; the framing closes in on his eyes and his eyelids stay open and still. The speaker (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, landing hard and flat on the last word, the voice comes from off-screen while nobody in frame moves their lips,: <d>[Chinese] 等待我们母子的，是屈辱。</d> while their lips remain completely closed. the score cuts out for half a second, then one low single note.

overall_soundscape:
A door clicking shut off-screen, then insects. The score cuts out for half a second, then one low single note.
